notes.title: Patch Notes | 08.07.2025
notes.notes:
Patch 1.31 is live snipers. The update includes a number of fixes which include improving the flow of the Kill List objective so Arno Lembke can be still killed if enemies are alerted before the letter is posted and in The Gallant Few resolved some issues where enemies would fail to spawn in.

As always a massive thank you to our wonderful community who have submitted bug reports and suggestions. Please check out a full list of notes below.
General 
Fixed an issue where controller inputs on PC occasionally displayed the wrong icons  

Resolved an issue where, under specific conditions, players could get into a state where they could not collect standard ammunition 

Fixed an issue where aiming directly up could cause the player’s character to bend unnaturally 

Resolved an issue where some facial animations briefly displayed incorrectly when crouched behind cover 

Reduced cases in Authentic mode where a white targeting box would appear around an enemy when scoped 

Fixed a case where, in certain circumstances, the Epilogue mission would not unlock after completing all other base campaign missions 

Corrected the unlock requirement for the last item slot in Campaign and Survival loadouts 

Improved the readability of the DLC labels in Russian 

Improved how the Resistance Fighter headgear fits on some characters 

Fixed an issue with the Razer Peripherals so that the keyboard lights are correct on the main menu 
Weapon Specific Fixes 
General Weapon fixes 

Fixed the .24 Shot special ammo’s stats displaying incorrectly in the loadout   

.303 MK1 – Fixed a bug where the kill feed would mention an incorrect weapon name for kills with this weapon 

Armaguerra OG-44 – Fixed tag for the Engraving skin in the loadout menu 

Auto-5 – Fixed the Golden Hex skin displaying incorrectly on the top of the weapon 

Gewehr 43 – Fixed an issue where the Overpressure Magazine & MG13 Trench Magazine would visually persist after reloading 

Hi-Power 9mm – Improved the appearance of several skins on the weapon and fixed incorrect attachment unlock display message for the Hi-Power Compensator muzzle 

M1912 – Fixed an issues where the ammo clip would visually persist after reloading and switching weapons 

M1918 BAR – Fixed an issue where the Brushstroke Camo cosmetic would not cover all parts of the weapon 

M1941 – Fixed description for Calibre Conversion magazine  

M1A1 Gov. – Improved the appearance of several skins on the weapon 

MAB Model D – Fixed the Golden Hex skin displaying incorrectly on the end of the weapon barrel 

Machine Pist.40 – Fixed the Golden Hex skin covering unintended surfaces 

Machine Pist.44 – Improved the appearance of several skins on the weapon 

MAS 36 – Fixed the Reinforced Band foregrip overlapping with cosmetic wraps 

Model1907 – Improved the appearance of several skins on the weapon 

SIG MKMS – Improved the appearance of several skins on the weapon 

Stengun MK2 – Improved the appearance of several skins on the weapon  

SVT-40 – The correct attachment unlock message now appears for the Performance Tuned barrel 

Thompson – Fixed an issue where skins did not display in iron sights aim 

Trench Gun – Fixed the Golden Hex skin displaying incorrectly when in iron sights aim 

Welrod – Fixed the Golden Hex skin displaying incorrectly when in iron sights aim 
Campaign Mission Fixes 
Behind Enemy Lines 

Fixed issues where the objective location was occasionally displayed incorrectly 

Fixed cases where soldiers were incorrectly labelled as Gestapo in the binoculars 

Improved cases where the player wouldn’t grab the edge on the metal platform near the Supply Depot 

Fixed cases where sound masking was present but no audio was playing  

Dead Drop  

Fixed various asset clipping, texture and lighting issues, and ladder animations 

Fixed some objective markers areas not disappearing part way through completion 

Sonderzuge Sabotage 

All walls in the green shed near the river are now solid 

Fixed an issue where the player could not fully climb a ladder on the archway at the end of the mission 

Adjusted hotel garden patrols to fix issues caused when raising the alarm 

Collision Course 

Improved the location marker for the “Find and eliminate intel sources” objective 

Resolved an issue where one of the Stone Eagles was not always visible from all intended locations 

Fixed the description of the kill list target when they are viewed by an invader 

Fixed issues with the player camera when using certain ladders in confined areas 

Devil’s Cauldron 

Improved crouch walking on the metal stairs at the entrance to the Kleine Blume area 

Fixed issues with the player camera when using certain ladders in confined areas 

Assault on Fort Rouge 

Fixed various asset clipping, texture and lighting issues, and ladder animations 

Removed an invisible wall on upper walkways inside the town 

Fixed some objective markers not disappearing part way through completion 

Players are no longer able to roll under the gates in the bunker 

Fixed an issue where players would get stuck part way up the stairs near the transponder location 

Fixed issues with the player camera when using certain ladders in confined areas 

Lock, Stock and Barrels 

Improved visibility in some areas when and aiming down sights over a railing 

The truck parked in the V1 Site area can now be destroyed as intended 

Improved cases where bullets we blocked on some objects behind the V1 launch ramp 

Search area circles now appear as intended throughout the mission 

End of the Line 

Fixed an issue where enemy AI soldiers could have issues traversing through the Blockhaus door when it was open and around it when it was closed 

Fixed an issue where the player would appear half crouched when walking through a specific tunnel 

Fixed an issue stopping players from completely climbing a ladder to a watch tower 

Improved camera angles when players use certain ladders 

Resolved an issue where under certain conditions the player’s character would not appear in the Loadout screen 

DLC: Lights, Camera, Achtung! 

Fixed various asset clipping and texture issues 

Fixed an issue where an enemy soldier was getting stuck on their patrol route  

Removed access to an unintended area where players could get stuck 

Fixed an issue where the objective could display incorrect text during the exfiltrate part of the objective 

DLC: Vercors Vendetta 

Improved the resolution of the Propaganda poster collectable when players are close to it and repositioned it slightly so it’s not clipping into the wall 

DLC: Striking Range 

Fixed an issue where enemy soldiers would be stuck under some stairs near the kill list target 

Fixed an issue where an enemy soldier would fire a flare gun under some camouflage netting. 

DLC: Mud and Thunder 

Fixed various floating objects, asset clipping, texture issues and lighting issues 

Improved camera angles when players climb certain ladders and vines 

Improved the flow of the Kill List objective so Arno Lembke can be still killed if enemies are alerted before the letter is posted 

Resolved an issue where, under certain conditions, the incorrect ammo would appear in a crate in the Underground Facility 

Fixed an issue where Arno Lembke could appear reluctant to move after the letter was given to him 

The poster in the Gestapo house is now the correct way around 

The Propaganda pop up now appears correctly alongside the Service Record update after collecting the Propaganda poster 

The fuel line to the rocket is now connected correctly 

Smoke now appears in all circumstances after completing V2 objective 

Fixed various translation and text display issues 

Fixed an issue causing some objective markers to not disappear after unselecting them 

Fixed an issue where certain enemies would automatically enter the investigation state shortly after starting the mission 

The destruction after completing the V2 objective now always triggers correctly 

Fixed some cases  of enemy soldiers AI getting stuck near the V2 launch site 

Improved image resolution for intro and outro videos 

Fixed an issue where a co-op player could spawn out of bounds 

Fixed enemy soldier patrol routes in some cases near the kill list target 

Fixed an issue where autosave could not trigger after completing the V2 Rockets objective 

Fixed the Destroy Resistance Documents objective not appearing when opening the locked door in certain ways 

Fixed and issue with the V2 Rocket when manual saving during the launch sequence 

Multiple issues fixed for co-op play when interacting with multiple rocket objectives at the same time 
Propaganda Specific Bug Fixes 
General 

Fixed an audio issue with the user interface 

Prendre Le Maquis 

Fixed a truck that was floating above the ground  

Résistance, Révolution, Vengeance  

Fixed a case where a truck would spawn incorrectly if the player went from the campaign level to the Propaganda version of the map 

Added the ability to vault over a few low walls that were missing the prompt 
Multiplayer Level Specific Bug Fixes 
General 

Made the instructions for unlocking the sixth item slot clearer 

Fixed some cases where unlock notification pop-ups would appear twice 

Deathmatch Chateau Grounds 

Removed an invisible wall on a balcony overlooking the main courtyard that was blocking grenade throws 

Blocked players from sprinting off one of the balconies to prevent them falling and taking damage 

Sniper Elite 5’s Deathmatch Landing Zone 

Fixed a case where players could get stuck if they walked on top of a fallen tree 

Sniper Elite 5’s No Cross Trident Beachhead 

Fixed a case where players could go prone under one of the large ships to pass inside it and have an unfair advantage  

Fixed a case where going prone between some metal barriers could cause the player character to fall out of the game world 

Blocked players from walking up a wall that allowed them to bypass the no-cross barrier 

Fixed an issue where some metal fences did not display properly 

Sniper Elite 5’s Alpine Resort 

Fixed a case where some white paint would not display properly from certain distances and angles 

No Cross Fortress 

Fixed a couple of cases where parts of the environment were incorrectly lit 

No Cross River Front 

Fixed some cases where players could enter unintended parts of the map and gain an advantage 

Resolved a case where going prone between some crates and a metal barrier could cause players to fall out of the game world 

Resolved a case where going prone under some scaffolding could cause players to fall out of the game world 

Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in a falling animation near a barrel on one of the bridges 
Survival Specific Bug Fixes 
Survival Fortress Command 

Fixed an issue where players could not pass next to a bench near command post C  

Fixed an issue where players could fail to grab a ledge and fall into an intended inaccessible area and get stuck 

Survival Mark of the Eagle  

Moved the medkit spawn location to inside the supply crate for consistency 

Survival Tide of War 

Fixed some railings to allow the player to now vault over 

Fixed a case where the enemy soldiers could shoot through a wall 

Survival The Gallant Few 

Resolved some issues where enemies would fail to spawn in 

Adjusted some elements near the edge of the playable space to make it visually clear why the player cannot travel down to the riverbed area 

Moved a sniper spawn location closer to the player so they can be more effective 

Improved how enemies approach the player after the command post changes 

Fixed an issue where a sniper could fall out of the map when sustaining non-lethal damage 

Resolved some issues where enemies would fail to approach the target command post 

Fixed an issue where an enemy bike could get stuck outside the playable space 

Fixed an issue where enemies could fail to detect players if they were positioned on a wooden bridge 

Resolved issues where enemies could get stuck when approaching players 

Fixed an issue where players could get stuck between a truck and some sandbags 

Please continue to send us your bug reports. Including screenshots, video clips and full descriptions of the issues you might encounter will be hugely beneficial. Our Player Support portal is here.

See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Patch Notes | 17.06.2025
notes.notes:
Patch 1.30 has been deployed snipers. The update includes a number of fixes which include mission completions being registered correctly, Survival medals being awarded as intended and pistol stocks no longer clipping through the character models.

A massive thank you to our incredible community who have submitted bug reports and game suggestions. It's always massively appreciated. Please check out a full list of notes below.


Additional Content  Paid Content (included as part of the season pass) 
New DLC Map: Mud and Thunder 

New DLC Propaganda challenge: Résistance, Révolution, Vengeance  

New Weapons: Auto-5 Shotgun + MAS 36 Rifle 

New Weapon Skin: Golden Hex 

New Weapon Skin: Brushstroke Camo 
Free content (redeemed from the store) 
SE5 Weapon – Mod.712 

New character skin – Marie 

New character skin – Lady of Liberty 
Free content (included as part of the patch) 
Free New Survival Map: The Gallant Few 

Free SE5 DM Map: Trident Beachhead 

Free SE5 Survival Map: Unwanted Guests 

 
General Bug Fixing 
Added several fixes to improve level unlocks for campaign missions played out of sequence whilst in co-op 

Fixed some cases where mission completion was not being registered correctly and therefore not giving appropriate unlocks 

Fixed an issue where dialogue could play whilst the level is loading after moving from an older patch patch to the latest patch 

Reduced cases where players could encounter a crash when completing a mission  

Made aesthetic improvements to entering the scope at extreme angles 

Fixed an issue where the player card would overlap with chat text in multiplayer in some languages 

Corrected some labels for attachments to indicate which ones come from DLC weapons 

Fixed an issue where the Paratrooper Beret did not display visually on the US Paratrooper skin 

Fixed an issue where medals referring to the ‘Vercors Vendetta’ mission were not labelled correctly 

Fixed an issue where a medal referring to the ‘Light’s Camera Achtung!’ mission was not labelled correctly 

Fixed an issue in the settings where if players turned voice chat off and on, they could not change the voice chat mode until refreshing the page 

Added survival medals for some of the maps that did not have them previously 

Fixed an issue where the text was cut off in the notification when achieving the ‘That’s a wrap’ medal 

 

 
Weapon Specific Bug Fixes General Weapon issues 
Fixed an issue where some weapons did not unlock correctly when reaching the required campaign progress  

Fixed an issue where the 7.5mm Conversion Magazine did not increase Muzzle Velocity 

Fixed an issue where the ‘Magazine Pouch’ attachment was incorrectly requiring kills in MP. It is now unlocked through campaign progress. 

Fixed an issue where the ‘Leather charging Handle’ had incorrect unlock requirements 

Fixed an issue where large Pistol Stocks would display clipping through the character on the loadout screen 

Fixed some UI text in Axis invasion that would get cut-off when playing in Russian 

Fixed some text on the collectable ‘Scuttle Instructions’ from the ‘Devil’s Cauldron’ mission that would get cut-off when playing in Russian 

 

Gewehr 43 – Fixed an issue where the Liberation wrap would not display correctly on this weapon if the ‘Extended Marksman’ barrel attachment was used 

Trench Gun – Fixed an issue where a shotgun shell would incorrectly display close to the trigger when using a female character  

Karabiner 98 – Fixed an issue where the ‘Thin Grip Tape’ attachment would clip through the Ghillie Rifle Elite wrap if they were both equipped at the same time  

M1A1 Gov. – Fixed an issue where certain cosmetic skins failed to display on the stock of the weapon 

DL Carbine – Fixed some cases where progress was not being registered properly for the ‘Extended Suppressor Barrel’ attachment unlock. 

Armaguerra OG-44 –  

Corrected the description text for the ‘Extended Magazine’ attachment 

Improved the reload animation for this weapon 

ZK-420S – Fixed an issue where the ‘Reenforced Band’ attachment would clip into each of the available rifle wraps  

Mars Automatic – Fixed an issue where skins for this weapon would appear low-resolution on some platforms 

SVT-40 – Fixed an issue where the Ghillie Elite wrap would not display correctly when used in combination with either the ‘Short Carbine’ or ‘Heavy Parkerized’ barrel attachments 

M1918 BAR – Fixed an issue where the ‘Rubber Buttplate’ attachment would not display correctly on certain platforms 

 

 
Campaign Level Specific Bug Fixes 
Behind Enemy Lines 

Fixed an issue where co-op partners could fall out of the game world if they joined whilst the host player was stood close to the generator objective 

Fixed an issue where if both Flak cannons were destroyed at the same time in co-op, the flak cannons could display incorrectly 

Dead Drop  

Corrected an issue where a set of vines was not climbable in invasion mode 

Fixed a case where co-op partners would spawn inside a wooden platform if the ‘Scaffold Yard’ alternative start location was used. 

Fixed an issue where if the player knocked the kill list target unconscious, placed him near the rat bomb and shot it, the challenge would not register as completed 

Sonderzuge Sabotage 

Fixed an issue where the player character’s feet would clip through the floor at an overlook close to the default mission start point 

Fixed an ammo pick-up that did not give the correct amount of ammo 

Fixed an issue where the player character could get stuck permanently falling if they stood in a certain spot between some train couplings 

Fixed an issue where a body crate would remain lit even after surrounding lights had been shot out 

Fixed a case where one of Harry’s dialogue lines would still play even if the player was not playing as Harry 

Fixed an issue where a duplicate intact tank model could appear as one got destroyed 

Fixed an issue where players could pass through a railing 

Removed a visual bug where players could see out of the game world in the garden area 

Fixed an issue where the player could not go prone on one of the metal walkways 

Collision Course 

Fixed an issue where players can hang but not be able to get back up on the railing used for the kill list challenge 

Added a window frame that was missing from one of the windows near the railway station 

Added a missing prompt for the drop-down option on one of the ladders on the Damn 

Fixed an issue to ensure co-op partners spawn with the player when they use an alternate start point to start the level 

Devil’s Cauldron 

Removed some invisible collision around the submarine dock so it doesn’t stop bullets 

Assault on Fort Rouge 

Fixed a ledge takedown being briefly delayed before the kill actually occurs 

Improved the collision of a ladder by an AA gun so the player can no longer occasionally run through it 

Lock, Stock and Barrels 

Fixed a rock wall so it now correctly uses its high-resolution textures 

Removed some invisible collision around a body crate so it doesn’t stop bullets 

Fixed a ladder so the player can now climb up it 

Fixed an issue where if you threw a knocked out sniper of the top of the windmill the objective marker wouldn’t be removed from the now dead body  

Adjusted some curtains so they no longer go through some open windows 

End of the Line 

Removed some invisible collision in a crater 

Fixed a rare instance where enemies could go through a set of stairs 

Removed an unnecessary section of floating railing 

Adjusted a rock so its no longer floating a bit above the ground 

Modified the walls on turret locations so they have higher detailed textures 

Fixed the distance to a flak gun when tracking the objective 

Fixed the Zugwerfer turret so its now destroyed after shooting it 

Fixed a rare instance where you could spawn at the wrong start location 

Fixed a ladder on a roof where looking down it would cause terrain to disappear 

Improved the lighting on the outro cutscene 

DLC: Lights, Camera, Achtung! 

Fixed rare instance when picking up a body would leave the body on the floor 

Adjusted the lighting in a few places to help them match the surroundings 

Removed the ability to get stuck when dropping off a caged ladder 

Fixed a small visible hole in the terrain by the battery cannon 

Fixed the spawn location for a client when the host is in a few locations in the level 

Fixed the biography of the hidden gnome as it was displaying the wrong one 

Fixed a flicker shadow in the church 

Fixed the black sections of ears on the loading screen 

Fixed objects not appearing when looking out of a warehouse 

Fixed the Xbox app progression bar for 'Take 5, and.. ACHTUNG!' so it now tracks correctly 

DLC: Vercors Vendetta 

Fixed the “Lucky Rabbit’s Foot” collectible displaying the wrong description 

Fixed some collision where you could climb down and through the ground 

Fixed a lantern so it can now be destroyed 

Adjust some collision to stop the player being able to fall into and then get stuck in a mine cart 

Adjust the geometry so the player can no longer see a motorbike in the distance from the start point 

Removed some invisible collision outside the windmill so the player can shoot through it 

Fixed the propaganda poster pickup notification not correctly showing the level name 

Fixed the spawn location for a client when the host is in a few locations in the level 

Adjusted the lighting on the player when they are by some sandbags at the Artillery Battery 

Fixed the lighting in a couple of spots in the windmill 

Removed the ability to go prone on stairs around the North Nerbelwerfer 

Fixed the propaganda poster sometimes appearing low resolution 

DLC: Striking Range 

Fixed the lighting when using the Harbour Cave workbench 

Fixed one of the German voice lines was not being played correctly 

Fixed the collision on a wooden crate 

Removed a section of invisible collision on some railings stopping bullets passing through it  

Improved the collision at the bottom of some stairs 

Fixed If the kill list target runs to the nearby stairs he no longer gets stuck 

Fixed some instances where doing a stealth takedown near boxes could cause the body to fall through the geometry 

Fixed a small area of missing geometry to stop falling through the map 

Fixed a section of invisible collision stopping the flare guns flare by some stairs 

Moved a Schu-mine so its no longer partially in a crate 

Removed some invisible collision a section of a battlement so it can be shot through 

Added the end of a small wall that was missing 

Fixed a rare instance where enemies could shoot through a section of the floor 

Add a few extra sets of bolt cutters to the level 

Adjusted a couple of paintings so they are now flush against the walls 

Fixed the ability to climb up a vine by the bridge 

Added collision to some sandbags on a wall to stop the player being able to see through them when next to them 

Fixed a zipline which wasn’t able to be used 

Fixed enemy reinforcements that arrive now patrolling once they are no longer in an alerted state 

Modified the name of one of the keys to help explain what its for 

Removed the ability to get out of the playable area at one of the lookout towers 

Add a few more satchel charges to the level 

Adjusted a poster near the church so it is now flush against the wall 

Fixed a hole the player could drop down and be stuck on some barrels 

Moved a small patch of grass so its positioned correctly 

The information on the in-game store page now scrolls so you can see all the content in the DLC 

Fixed a few textures on a battlement so they appear correctly 

Adjusted the lighting on the water in the sewers to closer match the surroundings 

Fixed some light bleeding through a wall by a road 

Added shadows to a few crates that were missing them 

Fixed one of the subtitles not displaying correctly when in the underground area with the kill target 

Improved a couple of translations for the tagged info on the kill target 

Fixed subtitles not displaying correctly for a Jager 

Fixed the spelling of the 'Vergeltungswaffe' medal in Portuguese (Brazil) 

Fixed the biography information of the tagged reinforcements around the Castle 

Adjusted a couple of textures on the road near the Castle 

Added more glow to one of the lamps in the basement 

Adjusted the level description box on the menu so it doesn’t get overlapped by the objective star 

Fixed up a small black area underneath a sandbag wall 

Fixed the ability for the camera to clip into a few things in the Sea Cave 

Lowered the amount of invasion phones in the level 

Switched the idle animations for a Spotter 

Improved the lighting in a tent in Castle area 

Fixed the Kill Target so when he is pacified his body falls correctly 

Removed any light bleeding through the stairs near the jail 

Adjusted the collision on some rubble when the player is prone 

Improved the lighting in one of the side rooms in the facility 

Modified a few small textures in a corridor so they aren’t so dark 

Adjusted the height position of an enemy leaning against a wall 
Propaganda Specific Bug Fixes 
General 

Fixed where if the player had unlocked a propaganda challenge and tried to load it but had uninstalled that DLC, it will now take you to the correct store page to re-install that DLC 

Fixed an exploit where the player could use traps to kill enemies but not start the timer 

Vivre Libre Ou Mourir 

The loading screen now shows the date of the operation 

Updated the amount of enemies on the menu to match the amount in level 

Pour Les Français 

Updated the amount of enemies on the menu to match the amount in level 

 
Multiplayer Level Specific Bug Fixes 
Deathmatch St.Raymond  

Fixed when shooting through the open Café windows they no lower have glass effects  

SE5 Map - Deathmatch  Landing Zone  

Improved the lighting in certain areas so places no longer feel overly dark 

No Cross Alpine Gorge 

Fixed an exploit to be able to get out of the level boundary 

No Cross Fortress 

Improved the collision on the wooden platform near the ‘Stream Crossing’  

Fixed an exploit to be able to get out of the level boundary 

 
Survival Specific Bug Fixes Survival General 
On the menu the lines connecting the command posts now all connect correctly 

The ‘Survivor’ ribbon now also unlocks when completing a DLC survival map 

Fixed that completing a DLC survival map now counts to skin unlocks 

SE5 Map - Survival Pest control  

Fixed the map zoom level when selecting Operation Monarch on the menu 

There is now a best score medal for the survival map 

Survival Fortress Command 

The vines at the back of a building are no able to be climbed up 

Generator near the Central Apartment Block is now correctly position at ground level 

Survival Mark of the Eagle  

Fixed a chest high wall not able to be vaulted over 

Survival Tide of War 

Fixed enemies being able to shoot through a specific wall in the Courtyard Apartments 

Fixed a small amount of terrain not correctly appearing when hidden behind a wall 

Please continue to send us your bug reports. Including screenshots, video clips and full descriptions of the issues you might encounter will be hugely beneficial. Our Player Support portal is here.

See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Patch Notes | 29.04.2025
notes.notes:
Snipers,

Patch 1.20 has been deployed and includes a number of fixes, including fixing a bug where the player could have no items in their loadout, an issue where medals were not always tracked correctly when completing a level on Authentic difficulty and rebalancing the damage over distance fall-off for a number of weapons.

The community has been essential in getting reports in quickly, so a huge thank you from the team. Please continue to get in touch as it helps massively in getting quick resolves implemented. See below for a full list of patch notes.
Additional Content

Paid Content (included as part of the season pass)


 New DLC Map: Striking Range
 New DLC Propaganda challenge: Vivre Libre Ou Mourir
 New Weapons: SVT 40 + Mars Automatic
 New Skins: Resistance Fighter (Harry) + Ghillie Suit Elite (Harry)
 New Rifle Wrap: Ghillie Rifle Wrap Elite


Free content (redeemed from the store)


 SE5 Weapon – D.L. Carbine
 New Rifle Wrap – Covert Elite Rifle Wrap


Free content (included as part of the patch)


 Free New No Cross Variant of SER Multiplayer Map Fortress: Destroyed Town
 Free SE5 DM Map: Landing Zone
 Free SE5 Survival Map: Tide Of War


General Bug Fixing


 Added additional safety checks to trigger the ‘Master-at-arms’ achievement for players who have met the requirements
 Fixed a rare instance where enemy soldiers were getting stuck in an alerted stated
 Fixed a bug where the player could have no items in their loadout
 Fixed the description text for a shot distance medal in ‘End of the Line’
 Extra checks added to the ‘Secondary Supremacy’ medal to ensure the tally updates correctly
 Fixed an issue with an incorrect pop-up notification appearing after killing after killing 20 invaders
 Fixed an issue where the player could get a ribbon for completing a Survival map but not the associated trophy / achievement
 Fixed a Spanish text error in the Service Record for a collectible from ‘Collision Course’
 Fixed a description text error for the ‘Survivalist’ medal to reflect only needing to complete a single survival map
 Fixed the description text for the ‘Oh Gnome you don’t’ medal to correctly show the amount required to unlock it
 Extra checks added to the ‘Crème de la Crème’ medal to ensure that it is unlocked once the criteria have been met
 Extras checks added to the ‘Pen Pals’ medal to ensure that it is unlocked once the criteria have been met at all medal ranks
 Fixed a description text error for the ‘That’s a Wrap’ medal
 Fixed an issue where certain subtitles wouldn’t play on Authentic difficulty
 Fixed an issue with being unable to perform Takedowns on enemies that are leaning against a wall
 Fixed several characters hair clipping through the German Field Cap
 Fixed an issue in German where a Tutorial title wouldn’t nicely fit over two lines
 Fixed an issue where the camera could clip slightly into the wall when going into scope when next to it
 Fixed an issue where the player character could drop off climbed vertical pipes to their death
 Improved the loading time of the high-resolution textures on the Service Record
 Fixed an issue where some Kill List Targets would not be alerted by thrown bottles nearby
 Fixed an issue where medals were not always tracked correctly when completing a level on Authentic difficulty
 Improved messaging when an Axis invasion rematch is denied


Weapon Specific Bug Fixes

General Weapon issues


 Rebalanced the damage over distance fall-off for a number of weapons
 Fixed an issue where the ‘Reduced Load Magazine’ could get stuck attached to some rifles after interacting with a Pistol workbench
 Fixed several cases where magazines would be displayed on the stock of the weapon in addition to the standard location.
 Fixed some text issues with weapon descriptions
 Fixed some text issues with unlock requirements for weapons
 Fixed an issue where a pop-up displayed an incorrect weapon attachment unlock for SMG’s
 Fixed an issue with progress tracking for the unlock of the A2 optical scope
 Fixed various weapon stats displayed for ‘Rate of Fire’
 Fixed an issue with “Reinforced Band”, “Bramit Suppressor”, “Maxin 1910 Suppressor” and “HUB 23 Supressor” unlock requirements
 Fixed various bugs in which the weapon would clip with the player character
 Fixed various stats for special ammo
 Corrected the description for the ‘Heavy Bolt’ receiver attachment


Gewehr 43 – Fixed and issue where a magazine attachment was positioned too high

Mas 44 – Corrected the unlock criteria text for the Extended Magazine attachment

Model 1907 – Made improvements to mitigate cases where triggering a reload only partially reloaded the weapon

M1A1 Gov. – Corrected typo in description for the 30RD magazine

Welrod – Corrected the unlock requirement text for the ‘Reinforce Overpressure’ Receiver attachment

Nagant M1895 – Improved animation displayed whilst carrying a body and using this weapon

Erma.36 – Improved the aesthetics of the Engraving skin on this weapon

.32 Ruby


 Fixed some parts of the grip that displayed incorrectly as pink
 Improved the holding animation for female characters using this weapon


Armaguerra OG-44


 Reduced model clipping when aiming down the weapon sights
 Improved the appearance of the Liberation DLC skin on this weapon

PIAT (temporary weapon)


 Improved animation when aiming at harsh angles
 Fixed an issue where kills with this weapon displayed incorrectly in the Kill-feed

ZK-420S – Fixed an issue in which the DLC Liberation Skin would obscure iron sights
Campaign Level Specific Bug Fixes

Behind Enemy Lines


 Fixed an issue where the level would not render outside the house in the Outro cutscene
 Fixed an issue where the cracks on the dam could display twice in a cutscene


Dead Drop


 Improved collision boxes to help the player mount curbs when carrying bodies
 Fixed an enemy going out of bounds on the map
 The ‘Search Vertigo’s Apartment’ objective now correctly updates once the player reaches the first floor of Vertigo’s apartment
 Removed the invisible wall by the zipline near to the underground entrance to the town
 Removed a little box from on top of a set of sandbag walls
 Fixed a bug where the lighting on Harry when he is in an underground area is brighter than it’s meant to be
 Improved the collision box for a few small pillars at the ends of walls
 Improved the collision on a few sets of stairs to make it easier to go up or down them and to match up with the players legs better
 Fixed the characters leg position when on the wooden platform near the start of the level
 Improved the collision of a set of climbable vines to now make the character closer to the wall
 Fixed a lighting bug on a wall outside the library
 Removed the invisible wall by the stone wall near the start of the level
 Improved the rendering on the fountain in the church gardens
